newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco seeks investors for silica sand mine.
newsitem.headline: Morocco seeks investors for silica sand mine.

text.p: Morocco on Monday launched a public tender for investment in a silica sand mine located in the northern province of Tangier.
The state-owned Bureau de Recherches et de Participations Minieres (BRPM) which made the offer said the closing date for the tender was April 4, 1997.
"In the framework of a partnership or total cession, BRPM aims at selecting investors who are interested in developing the silica sand mine of Dar Chaoui, located in Tangier province," BRPM said.
A technical visit to the mine will be organised by the bureau on February 3, 1997, it added.
BRPM, which is expected to be partly privatised by end 1998, launched in October and November two tenders for investment respectively in a gold and silver mines located in southern Morocco.
ONA Group, Morocco's largest private conglomerate, recently bought at a minimum price of 648.8 million dirhams four mines under BRPM control.
